name: coreto
description: Plataforma aberta de comunidades com chat em tempo real e salas de voz

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w e2e
scripts.e2e: npm run db:generate -w server && npm run build && npm run test -w e2e
